title: Data augmentation using generative networks to identify dementia
abstract: arXiv:2004.05989v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data limitation is one of the most common issues in training machine learning classifiers for medical applications. Due to ethical concerns and data privacy, the number of people that can be recruited to such experiments is generally smaller than the number of participants contributing to non-healthcare datasets. Recent research showed that generative models can be used as an effective approach for data augmentation, which can ultimately help to train more robust classifiers sparse data domains. A number of studies proved that this data augmentation technique works for image and audio data sets. In this paper, we investigate the application of a similar approach to different types of speech and audio-based features extracted from interactions recorded with our automatic dementia detection system. translated_title: 使用生成网络进行数据增强以识别痴呆症
translated_abstract: 数据限制是训练医疗应用机器学习分类器时最常见的问题之一。由于伦理问题和数据隐私，能够招募到此类实验的人数通常少于贡献给非医疗数据集的参与者人数。近期研究表明，生成模型可以作为一种有效的数据增强方法，最终有助于在稀疏数据领域训练更鲁棒的分类器。许多研究已证明这种数据增强技术适用于图像和音频数据集。在本文中，我们研究了将类似方法应用于从自动痴呆症检测系统记录的交互中提取的多种语音和音频特征。我们使用两种生成模型，展示了生成的合成样本如何提升基于DNN的分类器的性能。
tldr: 本文将生成模型数据增强方法应用于痴呆症检测系统的语音和音频特征，证明合成样本可以有效提升基于深度神经网络的痴呆症分类器性能，从而解决医疗数据稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: This paper applies generative-model-based data augmentation to speech and audio features from a dementia detection system, demonstrating that synthesized samples can improve the performance of DNN-based dementia classifiers despite limited medical data.
